lines.en: Steps heavy like a giant

lines.zh: 我踩着碎步绕到你侧面。
lines.en: I shuffle around to your side.
Muscles tremble as it walks
Wildness flickers in its eyes
Sound of its feet on the ground
Solid steps like a boulder
Low growl hints at strength
Muscles twitch with power
Moves slowly, like a beast
Earth shakes, here it comes

lines.zh: 老者踏着石阶慢慢下山
lines.en: The old man descends the stone steps slowly.

lines.zh: 拄着竹刀，一步一步地走
lines.en: Leaning on his bamboo blade, he walks step by step.
Stands still, watching around
Breath heavy as wind

lines.zh: 老夫坐着，听风辨你的位置。
lines.en: I sit still and track you by the wind.
Staring into the distance, deep in thought
Calm with a hint of authority
Occasionally growls, intimidating enemies
Scans surroundings, looking for threats
Breathing deep and strong
Strength in its silence
Stands still, ever vigilant
Its gaze locks on you
Sharp eyes fix on you
Staring at you, ready to attack
Focusing on you, ready to strike
Gaze like flames, threatening you
Killing intent in its eyes

lines.zh: 你出刀的姿势，我一寸寸看着。
lines.en: I watch each inch of your draw.
Holds you in its sights, ready to attack

lines.zh: 目光凶狠，你感受到威胁
lines.en: Fiery gaze, feeling the threat
Staring at you, ready to attack
Ouch, that hurts!
That stab really hurts!
That sword really hurts!
That cut is deep!
That axe really hurts!
That slash really hurts!
That claw really hurts!
That chop really hurts!
That stab really hurts!
That sword really hurts!

lines.zh: 你扔了块肉，慈悟郎咬了咬，露出尖牙。
lines.en: Mori threw a piece of meat, Jigoro gnashed his teeth.

lines.zh: 慈悟郎瞪了你一眼，似乎在思考是否攻击。
lines.en: Jigoro glared at Mori, considering the attack.

lines.zh: 慈悟郎舔了舔嘴唇，示意你靠近。
lines.en: Jigoro licked his lips, gesturing for Mori to come closer.

lines.zh: 你靠近慈悟郎，他用手指了指地面。
lines.en: Mori approached Jigoro, who pointed at the ground.

lines.zh: 慈悟郎伸出手，似乎在寻求帮助。
lines.en: Jigoro reached out, seemingly seeking assistance.

lines.zh: 你给慈悟郎喂了一块肉，他感激地看了你一眼。
lines.en: Mori fed Jigoro a piece of meat, who looked at him gratefully.

lines.zh: 慈悟郎好奇地盯着你手中的食物。
lines.en: Jigoro stared curiously at the food in Mori's hand.

lines.zh: 你递给慈悟郎一根骨头，他接过了。
lines.en: Mori offered Jigoro a bone, who took it.

lines.zh: 慈悟郎对食物感兴趣，慢慢靠近。
lines.en: Jigoro approached the food out of interest.

lines.zh: 慈悟郎看着你手中的肉，眼睛发光。
lines.en: Jigoro's eyes lit up at the sight of the meat.

lines.zh: 慈悟郎与你擦肩而过，你感到一阵寒意。
lines.en: Jigoro brushed past Mori, sending shivers down his spine.

lines.zh: 你与慈悟郎碰撞，他发出低沉的吼声。
lines.en: Mori collided with Jigoro, who rumbled lowly.

lines.zh: 慈悟郎与你发生了肢体冲突，你被撞退几步。
lines.en: Jigoro collided with Mori, pushing him back a few steps.

lines.zh: 你试图与慈悟郎对抗，却被他的护甲挡住了。
lines.en: Mori tried to fight Jigoro but was repelled by his armor.

lines.zh: 慈悟郎的攻击撞向你，你感受到强烈的冲击。
lines.en: Jigoro's attack collided with Mori, jarring him.

lines.zh: 你试图避开慈悟郎的攻击，但未成功。
lines.en: Mori tried to dodge Jigoro's attack but failed.

lines.zh: 慈悟郎用他的爪子撞向你，你感到疼痛。
lines.en: Jigoro's claws collided with Mori, causing pain.

lines.zh: 你与慈悟郎的碰撞使你踉跄后退。
lines.en: Mori staggered back from the collision with Jigoro.

lines.zh: 慈悟郎的护甲在你身上留下了印记。
lines.en: Jigoro's armor left marks on Mori.

lines.zh: 你与慈悟郎的碰撞中，你感到一阵剧痛。
lines.en: Mori felt intense pain from colliding with Jigoro.

lines.zh: 慈悟郎注视着同伴，眼神中充满温情。
lines.en: Jigoro gazed at his mate, his eyes filled with tenderness.

lines.zh: 慈悟郎与你的同伴产生了交配欲望。
lines.en: Jigoro developed mating interest in your companion.

lines.zh: 慈悟郎用他的长须触碰同伴，表达爱意。
lines.en: Jigoro used his long whiskers to touch his mate.

lines.zh: 慈悟郎与你的同伴互相磨蹭，表现出亲密。
lines.en: Jigoro rubbed against your companion, showing intimacy.

lines.zh: 慈悟郎的同伴向他靠近，他微笑着。
lines.en: Jigoro's mate approached, and he smiled.

lines.zh: 慈悟郎与你的同伴开始交配，显得十分专注。
lines.en: Jigoro and your companion began to mate, focusing intently.

lines.zh: 慈悟郎的同伴用尾巴轻轻拍打他，他笑了。
lines.en: Jigoro's mate gently tapped him with her tail, causing him to laugh.

lines.zh: 慈悟郎与你的同伴互相拥抱，显得亲密无间。
lines.en: Jigoro embraced your companion, showing great intimacy.

lines.zh: 慈悟郎用他的触须轻触同伴的脸颊。
lines.en: Jigoro gently touched his mate's cheek with his whiskers.

lines.zh: 慈悟郎与你的同伴开始交配，彼此间没有敌意。
lines.en: Jigoro and your companion began mating, showing no hostility.

lines.zh: 这孩子留下的刀锷，我收下。
lines.en: The sword guard this child left behind, I keep.

lines.zh: 鸣柱的力量现在属于我！
lines.en: The power of the Pillar of Sound is now mine!
Stay away from me!

lines.zh: 我是桑岛慈悟郎，不会再有下一个！
lines.en: I am Jigoro Kuwajima, and there will be no next one!
This is my land, get out!
You can't stop my path!

lines.zh: 拾起木刀，我先活动手腕。
lines.en: I pick up the wooden sword and loosen my wrists.
The balance of nature has changed!

lines.zh: 掉了的护手，我弯腰捡起来。
lines.en: A dropped gauntlet; I bend down to pick it up.
The will of the Pillar of Sound still exists!

lines.zh: 前鸣柱的刀，好久没出鞘。
lines.en: The former Thunder Pillar's blade, drawn at last.
Thunder breathing starts with this cut.
This is your death sentence!
Retired or not, a blade is still a blade.
You'll regret this day!
Feel my anger!

lines.zh: 老夫的脚程，你追不上也躲不开。
lines.en: You can't outrun these old legs, nor dodge them.
Shake now!
You're just an ant in my eyes!
Await your death!
He narrows his eyes and recognizes his visitor.

lines.zh: 竹刀抬起，指向你的胸口
lines.en: His bamboo blade rises, pointing at your chest.

lines.zh: 老者的气息一下收紧了
lines.en: The old man's presence suddenly tightens.

lines.zh: 他站定，把重心压到脚底
lines.en: He plants his feet and sinks his weight.
A short shout and he has chosen you.
He stops retreating and steps in.

lines.zh: 雷之呼吸的架势，我还没忘。
lines.en: I haven't forgotten the stance of Thunder Breathing.
My claws will crush you!
Feel my sharp claws!

lines.zh: 我这把老骨头，爪子还硬。
lines.en: Old bones, but these claws are still hard.
This is my hunt!
Feel my power, the end!
You are my food!
You will tremble under my feet!
This is the hunting time!
You are mine, forever!

lines.zh: 他绕着圈子，不急着出手
lines.en: He circles, in no hurry to strike.
The bamboo blade's tip trembles.

lines.zh: 他盯着你的肩，不看你的眼
lines.en: He watches your shoulders, not your eyes.

lines.zh: 脚步轻挪，卡住你的退路
lines.en: Light steps cut off your retreat.
He waits for you to move first.

lines.zh: 呼吸放慢，节奏稳了下来
lines.en: His breathing slows into a steady rhythm.

lines.zh: 他侧身站定，露出半边破绽
lines.en: He turns side-on, showing a feigned opening.

lines.zh: 老者的目光落在你的剑柄上
lines.en: His gaze rests on your sword hilt.
He takes half a step and stops.
He is counting your breaths.
Swinging bamboo sword!
Feel the bamboo sword's power!
End you with bamboo sword!
Bamboo sword cuts your flesh!
Sword slashes your head!
Can you block it?
I slash you with bamboo sword!
Bamboo sword cuts your limbs!
Pierce you with bamboo sword!
The cut lands before the thunder catches up.

lines.zh: 竹刀当头劈下，风声很沉
lines.en: The bamboo blade chops down with a heavy whoosh.

lines.zh: 一记横扫打在你的肋侧
lines.en: A sweep lands on your ribs.
His strike is too fast to follow.
The bamboo blade taps your wrist.
He steps back, turns, and chops backhand.
The flat of the blade knocks your guard aside.

lines.zh: 老者一击打中你的膝盖
lines.en: The old man's blow catches your knee.

lines.zh: 竹刀擦着你的耳朵过去
lines.en: The bamboo blade grazes past your ear.

lines.zh: 他压低身子，从下方挑上来
lines.en: He drops low and strikes upward.
This one lands square on your gut.
Jigoro Kuwajima reincarnates!
New challenger emerges!
Nature's roar!
Here I come!

lines.zh: 老师的身手，是不讲情面的。
lines.en: A teacher's skill shows no mercy.
I am Jigoro Kuwajima!
In the Overworld, my territory!

lines.zh: 老骨头的步子，还是这么重。
lines.en: Old bones, and my steps still land heavy.
Jigoro Kuwajima, awaken!
Natural power, gathered!
On the mountain path, the old man appears.

lines.zh: 他站在林间空地，等着谁
lines.en: He stands in the clearing, waiting for someone.
Fire burns!
Ouch, fell!

lines.zh: 唉哟，这刀伤得好疼，溺水的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: Ouch, that hurts! — and the drown makes it worse.

lines.zh: 这刀子扎得我好痛，遭爆炸的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: That stab really hurts! — and the explosion makes it worse.

lines.zh: 这剑砍得我好疼，中箭的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: That sword really hurts! — and the projectile makes it worse.

lines.zh: 刀子割得好深，中魔法的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: That cut is deep! — and the magic makes it worse.

lines.zh: 这斧头砸得好痛，挨饿的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: That axe really hurts! — and the starvation makes it worse.

lines.zh: 刀砍得好疼，遭雷击的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: That slash really hurts! — and the lightning makes it worse.

lines.zh: 这爪子抓得好痛，坠入虚空的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: That claw really hurts! — and the void makes it worse.
